verdict.rationale: three.js is a code-first JavaScript library installed via npm (and coding agents drive it through npm), so no editor is inherently required. However, the evidence documents no three.js build or export command and no headless CI pipeline of its own. Building and exporting would rely on external bundlers or Node tooling, which are user-side or host-platform capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor
